$description: DataGrid (platform/components/DataGrid): its own tokens beside the shared set: the footer of the modes "pages" and "load-more" (owner, 2026-10-14), the row height steps, the padding and lines of taller rows, the Airtable-style group rows, the column header type icons and wrapped headers (owner, 2026-10-14). The grid's other tokens are in the shared set.

data-grid-auto-max-width.$description: DataGrid: the widest a column grows to fit its content when it has no width of its own; longer text ends in an ellipsis with the full text on hover, and the last column takes the room that is left (owner, 2026-10-22).

data-grid-footer-border-color.$description: DataGrid footer: the line above it (a row's line).

data-grid-footer-text.$description: DataGrid footer: its text (the range or the count, the rows-per-page label), as Pagination's.

data-grid-footer-gap.$description: DataGrid footer: the space between its parts (Pagination's gap).

data-grid-footer-row-gap.$description: DataGrid footer: the space between its lines when the parts wrap in a narrow grid.

data-grid-footer-padding-block.$description: DataGrid footer: the space above and below its controls.

data-grid-footer-padding-inline.$description: DataGrid footer: the space at its start and end.

data-grid-footer-label-gap.$description: DataGrid footer: the space between the rows-per-page label and its Select (Pagination's per-page gap).

data-grid-fit-max-height.$description: DataGrid (fill, load-more): the body is at most one screen tall until the grid has measured the room left under where it starts (then that room, written on the body).

data-grid-record-height.$description: DataGrid: a record row's height. The row height step Short is the density's row height (36 / 40 / 48; owner, 2026-10-22); the grid's rowHeight sets the other steps on its frame (data-plx-row-height). Only record rows take it: the header row, group rows, the add row and the group gap keep their own heights.

data-grid-row-height-medium.$description: DataGrid row height step Medium: 56px at every density.

data-grid-row-height-tall.$description: DataGrid row height step Tall: 88px at every density.

data-grid-row-height-extra-tall.$description: DataGrid row height step Extra tall: 128px at every density.

data-grid-cell-padding-block.$description: DataGrid: P, the minimum room above and below a cell's content: a Short row's own vertical padding, (the density row height − the text line height) / 2 (6px at Standard). Taller rows start their content P from the top and keep at least P at the bottom.

data-grid-group-header-height.$description: DataGrid group header row: the density row height + 16px (44 / 48 / 56), the same at every row height step: the eyebrow line and the value line with P above and below.

data-grid-group-eyebrow-line-height.$description: DataGrid group header: the line of the eyebrow that names the grouped-by field.

data-grid-group-gap.$description: DataGrid: the band between two groups (lines above and below it), shown whether the groups are open or closed.

data-grid-group-background.$description: DataGrid group header row: the neutral sunken surface.

data-grid-grouped-column-background.$description: DataGrid: the grouped-by column (its header and its cells) is tinted with the neutral sunken surface.

data-grid-group-indent.$description: DataGrid: a nested group's header is indented one step per level.

data-grid-group-chevron-size.$description: DataGrid group header: the chevron that opens and closes the group.

data-grid-group-chevron-text.$description: DataGrid group header: the chevron's color.

data-grid-group-gap-inline.$description: DataGrid group header: the space between the chevron, the eyebrow and value, and the count.

data-grid-group-summary-gap.$description: DataGrid group header: the space between a summary's name and its value.

data-grid-group-summary-text.$description: DataGrid group header: a column summary's name (Sum, Average…).

data-grid-add-row-text.$description: DataGrid add row: the + and its words at the end of a group.

data-grid-header-wrap-height.$description: DataGrid with Wrap headers: the column header row, two lines tall (a fixed height, never measured).

data-grid-header-title-line-height.$description: DataGrid with Wrap headers: the line of a column title that wraps onto two lines.

data-grid-header-type-icon-text.$description: DataGrid column header: the type icon's color.

data-grid-menu-chevron-text.$description: DataGrid column header: the column menu's chevron button (the thin outline chevron, muted; owner, 2026-10-14), shown while the header is hovered.

data-grid-header-background-image.$description: DataGrid header: the silver band, gray 50 at the top to gray 200 at the bottom (owner, 2026-10-23, C).

data-grid-header-hover-background-image.$description: DataGrid header: a column under the pointer, one shade deeper, gray 100 to gray 300 (owner, 2026-10-23, H3).

data-grid-header-edge.$description: DataGrid header: the gray 400 line under it and before its options button (owner, 2026-10-23).

data-grid-header-hover-line.$description: DataGrid header: its column lines while the pointer is over it, gray 350 (owner, 2026-10-23, H3).

data-grid-header-hover-edge.$description: DataGrid header: the two lines of the column under the pointer, gray 400 (owner, 2026-10-23, H3).

data-grid-row-hover-line.$description: DataGrid: the lines of a row under the pointer, gray 300, so the row reads as a band of cells (owner, 2026-10-23, R2).

data-grid-row-selected-line.$description: DataGrid: the lines of a selected row, blue-gray 250 (owner, 2026-10-23, S2).

data-grid-row-selected-bar.$description: DataGrid: the bar at the start of a selected row, blue 600 (owner, 2026-10-23, S2).

data-grid-row-selected-bar-width.$description: DataGrid: the selected row’s start bar, 3px (the accent bar width the UI uses).

data-grid-menu-button-hover-background.$description: DataGrid header: the options button under the pointer, gray 200 (owner, 2026-10-23).

data-grid-menu-button-padding-inline.$description: DataGrid header: the options button’s sides (Windows Explorer: a narrow button the header’s height).

data-grid-menu-button-min-width.$description: DataGrid header: the options part is one target the header’s height and at least 24px wide, the chevron in its middle (owner, 2026-10-24: as Windows Explorer; WCAG 2.5.8).
